title: Naturally Buttery American Beef Skillet
description: A weeknight American dish featuring beef, tomatoes, and a rich buttery flavor, made with Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Remove the cooked beef from the skillet and set it aside.
Reduce heat to medium and add the butter to the skillet.
Once the butter has melted, add the diced onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes, salt, black pepper, and paprika to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the cooked beef to the skillet and stir to combine with the tomato mixture.
Reduce heat to low and simmer the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
Cook ground beef to an internal temperature of 71°C / 160°F (no longer pink in the middle) before serving.
